tools.name: screen_address
tools.description: Checks one crypto address against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list of sanctioned digital currency addresses (refreshed daily). For 2 or more addresses use screen_batch (up to 50 per call, counts as one call). Accepts any chain (BTC, ETH and EVM chains, TRX, SOL, LTC, XMR, BCH, XRP, ZEC and more). Free:

tools.name: screen_batch
tools.description: Checks 1-50 crypto addresses against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list in one call (counts as one call). Use it instead of repeated screen_address calls whenever you have several addresses (payee lists, counterparties, transaction inputs/outputs); use screen_address for a single one. Mixed chains allowe
